sources.title: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-0.8B-OptiQ-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-.8B-OptiQ-4bit Mixed-precision quantized with OptiQ — sensitivity-driven quantization for Apple Silicon This is a mixed-precision quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B in MLX format. Unlike uniform quantization (all layers at the same bit-width), OptiQ measures each layer's sensitivity and assigns optimal per-layer bit-widths, preserving model quality where it matters most. sources.title: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-0.8B-MLX-4bit — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: This model is a highly compressed 4-bit quantization of the Qwen3.5-0.8B architecture. Developed by Alibaba and hosted within the Modelers.cn ecosystem, it targets the 'Small Language Model' (SLM) niche, prioritising low latency and minimal memory footprint over massive knowledge capacity.

sources.title: Installing Qwen 3.5 on Apple Silicon Using MLX for 2X Performance
sources.snippet: Enter Qwen 3.5 MLX in the search field. Select a model (0.8B ,2B ,4B ,9B) explicitly labeled as MLX. - By default, LLM Studio is capable of displaying which models your device is capable of running. Alternatives This method uses MLX to run Qwen 3.5 models directly on Apple Silicon hardware.
